gates.name: Official source integrity
gates.rule: Every empirical row has an official NBA source URL; derived rows inherit it.

gates.name: Availability

gates.rule: Bet-time and closing quotes required for value/CLV; only two Nov 5 games have dynamic operator snapshots.

gates.name: Settlement rules
gates.rule: Operator-specific NBA/prop/parlay settlement must be recorded.

gates.name: Chronological replay
gates.rule: No future outcome may enter a forecast; expanding-window replay implemented.

gates.name: Sample size / power
gates.rule: Exact binomial evidence must clear family-wise alpha; current forecast sample is small.

gates.name: Multiple testing
gates.rule: Register all trials; Holm/Bonferroni utilities implemented; DSR requires full trial ledger.

gates.name: Economic realism
gates.rule: Executable price, limits, fees, voids and closing benchmark required; no ROI is reported.

gates.rule: Sponsor, budget, eligibility and payout terms must be verified before monetary rewards.

strategies.name: Team spread value vs market
strategies.hypothesis: Originate a pace/efficiency spread and compare with a timestamped market spread; trade only after calibration and availability gates.
strategies.evidence: 11 model-only slate lines; 2 Nov 5 operator quote snapshots

strategies.name: Team total value vs market
strategies.hypothesis: Originate a pace-interaction total and compare with market total; no edge without calibrated total distribution.

strategies.name: Expanding-median points reversion
strategies.hypothesis: After 20 prior games, fade a last-5 mean at least 2 points from the expanding median using a half-step reference line.
strategies.evidence: 47 chronological forecast rows; exact binomial vs 50%

strategies.name: Same-game PTS+AST threshold combo
strategies.hypothesis: Price joint threshold frequency directly rather than multiplying marginal rates; validate on matched prop lines.
strategies.evidence: Per-player historical joint rates and block CIs

strategies.name: Same-game PTS+AST+REB threshold combo
strategies.hypothesis: Three-leg joint frequency must be estimated directly; pairwise correlation is insufficient.

strategies.name: Cross-game two-leg team parlay
strategies.hypothesis: Combine qualified single legs only after measuring cross-game dependence and operator parlay repricing.
strategies.evidence: No cross-game leg correlation measured; within-player lag-1 is not a substitute

flags.issue: Official PACE/POSS not an exact identity
